description: We are a creative team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! Our project explores forgotten NASA equipment on the Moon and Mars through creative storytelling. We are interested in space, animation, graphic design and science. We are looking for enthusiastic members skilled in games, design, animation, Earth science and disaster response. Let’s create something amazing together!
summary: Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” explores NASA’s equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. It tells the stories of rovers, instruments and probes that completed their science missions or continue travelling away from Earth. We explain their purposes, discoveries and contributions to space science, reminding everyone that even when a mission ends, its discoveries remain valuable.
details: Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” explores NASA’s rovers, instruments and probes left on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. We explain their missions, purposes and discoveries through research and storytelling. Our goal is to make space science interesting, inspire young learners and show that even when a mission ends, its discoveries remain valuable. We use creativity and digital presentations to bring these forgotten explorers’ stories back to life.
